George du Maurier, Trilby.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/george-du-maurier/trilby

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- George du Maurier, the author, died 1896.

First publication of the text used: 1894 (SE colophon: 'Trilby was published in 1894 by George du Maurier'). The first publication was the serial in Harper's New Monthly Magazine, January to August 1894, and the book form on 8 September 1894 (Wikipedia, 'Trilby (novel)', https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trilby_(novel)).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1894, before 1931, so the United States public domain applies.
- Country of origin (United States, the first publication above): the United States rule settles it, so the text is public domain in its country of origin as well.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
